verdict.rationale: Postmark's 'Servers' construct (create/edit/list/delete servers, docs-51) each carry their own Server API Token (docs-37), can be attached to multiple custom sending domains (docs-26) and sender signatures (docs-20), giving platform engineers a practical way to isolate tenants with separate credentials and per-server suppression/bounce handling (docs-6, docs-33). However, there is no explicit 'subaccount'/'subuser' terminology, and true reputation isolation depends on paid dedicated IPs only available above 300k emails/month (docs-23/38), so smaller tenants likely share IP reputation. Missing for 10: explicit subaccount/subuser hierarchy documentation, clear per-tenant reputation isolation below the dedicated-IP threshold, and independent confirmation of tenant isolation at scale.
